info.name: InvoiceFlow API
info.description: Set baseUrl and accessToken (a Supabase access token). Generated by api/scripts/build-docs.ts.

request.description: Delete the account and all its data
Totals per currency, recent invoices and payments
Update business profile (only sent fields change)
Upload logo or signature (kind = logo | signature; PNG/JPEG, max 1 MB)
Soft-delete a customer (invoices keep their history)
List invoices (status filter includes overdue and outstanding)
Create an invoice (totals are computed by the server)
Get an invoice with items and tax breakdown
Replace an invoice (only before money is paid)
Move to sent, cancelled or paid (allowed transitions only)
Create an estimate (numbered EST-0001..; totals computed by the server)
Replace an estimate (until accepted, declined or converted)
Mark sent, accepted or declined (the owner records the customer's decision)
Turn into a DRAFT invoice with the same lines, once, atomically
Render the estimate as a PDF
Email the estimate PDF (marks a draft as sent only after delivery)
Render the invoice as a PDF
Email the invoice (marks a draft as sent only after delivery)
Create (or return) the public pay link
Start or resume Stripe Connect onboarding
Create a PaymentIntent for an invoice
Refund fully or partially (applied when Stripe confirms)
Record that the customer viewed the invoice
Start a payment from the public page
